content.title: Duel Rhythm | Stillness to Decisive Strike
content.summary: First establish quiet tension, transition into continuous high-density exchanges, then conclude with a decisive intervention, brief false stability, and delayed resolution.

quick_start.input_format: Two subjects/systems + readable stillness + continuous high-density exchange + one decisive intervention + brief pseudo-stability + delayed resolution
quick_start.recommended_input: Two groups of kinetic sculptures first stand in static opposition, then engage in a continuous exchange of high-speed magnetic plates. One group delivers a single reverse pulse, briefly restoring calm before the other structure collapses seconds later.
required_anchors: Mid-section exchange is continuous and high-density
Irreversible results occur after false stability
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First establish quietly, enter into continuous intensive exchange, and then end with a decisive intervention, short-term false stability and delayed results.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Organize a two-agent confrontation into three readable states: measured stillness, one continuous dense exchange, and a single decisive intervention. After the intervention, preserve one short false-stability beat before an irreversible physical consequence confirms the result; end on the initiator's controlled state rather than another attack.

invariants.rule: Begin with readable stillness and a clear relation between both agents.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate action removes the contrast state.

invariants.rule: Treat the middle as one continuous exchange rather than unrelated highlights.
invariants.ablation_failure: Disconnected cuts make the decisive event arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Use only one identifiable state-changing intervention.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple finishers compete for causal credit.

invariants.rule: Hold a short false-stability beat after intervention.
invariants.purpose: Lets the audience register cause before effect.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate collapse loses the delayed proof.

invariants.rule: Confirm the outcome through irreversible physical state while the initiator stays controlled.
invariants.ablation_failure: A reaction-only ending fails to prove the result.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original subject or system whose identity remains stable.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One visible variable that changes in countable causal stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained behavior rule that makes the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A coherent information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: One clean physical or graphic consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: A new hierarchy of diegetic cues supporting state changes.

anti_copy_exclusions: blade trap, finishing cut and delayed kneeling fall
